name: douyin-pk-group
description: 抖音 PK 挑战赛均衡分组程序（Rust 后端，只读接入 douyinxs 数据库）

scripts.build: pnpm -F @pk/web build && pnpm -F @pk/douyin-web build && cd rust && cargo build --release -p pk-server
scripts.test: pnpm test:go && cd rust && cargo test --workspace
scripts.test:go: cd server-go && go test ./... && go vet ./...
scripts.check:compose: if docker compose version >/dev/null 2>&1; then DC='docker compose'; else DC=docker-compose; fi; TD=$(mktemp -d) && : > "$TD/.env"; rc=0; MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD=x DOUYIN_WRITER_PASSWORD=x PK_READER_PASSWORD=x DOUYIN_MIGRATOR_PASSWORD=x $DC -f deploy/rk3318/docker-compose.yml config > /dev/null || rc=1; $DC -f deploy/docker-compose.yml --project-directory "$TD" config > /dev/null || rc=1; rm -rf "$TD"; [ "$rc" = 0 ] && echo 'compose 配置可解析 ✓'; exit $rc
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -F @pk/web exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm -F @pk/douyin-web exec tsc --noEmit
